# Live by Significant Hobbies

> A life planner for private daily rituals and public living: hobbies, bucket
> lists, experiences, and side quests over time.

Next.js on Cloudflare Workers. Google auth is optional for saving private
practice and timelines; the discovery corpus and opt-in profiles are public.

## When to use this

Use this site and its agent surfaces when the task is:

- **Hobby discovery** — finding a hobby that fits constraints (budget, time,
  available space, prior experience) via the quiz, taxonomy, and category browse.
- **Bucket lists and life planning** — assembling, comparing, and starting
  life-list items and experiences, including milestone framing (before 30/50,
  travel, life bingo, life in weeks).
- **Tracking practices over time** — understanding how hobbies, side quests,
  and rituals accumulate across a life (public timelines and editorial journeys).
- **Researching how hobbies shape notable lives** — the famous-journeys corpus.

Do NOT use this for:

- Reading or writing a specific user's private daily practice, journal, or
  habit check-ins (auth-walled; not agent-indexed).
- Real-time personal reminders, notifications, or scheduling.
- Medical, mental-health treatment, or financial advice (the mental-health
  framing is about hobby selection, not care).
- Purchasing gear or booking experiences directly (the site links out; it is
  not a marketplace).

## Discover

- [Home](https://live.significanthobbies.com/): Product landing and life-planning frame
- [Explore](https://live.significanthobbies.com/explore): Public hobby timelines
- [Hobbies](https://live.significanthobbies.com/hobbies): Hobby taxonomy and category browse
- [Experiences](https://live.significanthobbies.com/experiences): Things you could do and how to begin
- [Famous journeys](https://live.significanthobbies.com/journeys): How hobbies changed across notable lives
- [Bucket lists](https://live.significanthobbies.com/bucket-lists): Public lists and practical starting points
- [Blog](https://live.significanthobbies.com/blog): Long-form articles about hobbies and living deliberately

## Start

- [Find your hobby](https://live.significanthobbies.com/find-your-hobby): Guided hobby discovery
- [Life in weeks](https://live.significanthobbies.com/life-in-weeks): Anonymous mortality and time-planning tool
- [Life bingo](https://live.significanthobbies.com/life-bingo): Build a life list without an account

## Agent access

- [Agent catalog](https://live.significanthobbies.com/api/ai): JSON inventory of bounded public surfaces
- [OpenAPI spec](https://live.significanthobbies.com/openapi.json): Machine-readable API description
- [Homepage Markdown](https://live.significanthobbies.com/index.md): Product brief without JavaScript
- [Full article index](https://live.significanthobbies.com/llms-full.txt): Canonical editorial corpus
- Every public sitemap route supports `Accept: text/markdown` and a `.md` alternate.
- Authenticated daily practice and private user data are not agent-indexed.

## Developer docs

- [OpenAPI specification](https://live.significanthobbies.com/openapi.json): Full API surface description (OpenAPI 3.1)
- [Agent catalog](https://live.significanthobbies.com/api/ai): JSON inventory of public agent surfaces

## CLI

```bash
# Fetch the agent catalog
curl -s https://live.significanthobbies.com/api/ai | jq .

# Get the OpenAPI spec
curl -s https://live.significanthobbies.com/openapi.json | jq .

# Fetch the homepage as markdown
curl -s -H 'Accept: text/markdown' https://live.significanthobbies.com/

# Fetch the full agent brief
curl -s https://live.significanthobbies.com/llms-full.txt
```
